purpose: Assemble a source-bound, time-aware context for an initiative decision without treating a projection as a canonical fact or an approved recommendation.

inputs.scope: A canonical initiative or capability identifier.
inputs.observations: W3 immutable source-bound observations for explicitly requested dimensions.
inputs.strategic_evidence: W6 reviewed evidence packets for explicitly requested claims.
inputs.audience: One requested audience; client and restricted content are never combined.
inputs.as_of: The point in valid time at which status and evidence are evaluated.
inputs.known_at: The information cutoff; future-recorded, future-captured, or revoked material is unavailable.
inputs.authorization_context: Authenticated principal with a closed-world granted audience and classification clearance.
inputs.reference_monitor: Immutable source-assertion resolver and non-bypassable pre-projection access control.

invariants: Every required observation dimension is projected using the W3 temporal rules.
Every requested strategic claim is projected using the W6 evidence and audience rules.
A missing, expired, or future required observation never becomes a current status.
A conflict in a required observation or a W6 HITL requirement blocks decision readiness.
A support-only strategic claim remains candidate-only and visibly exposes the counterevidence gap.
The projection exposes source assertion IDs for every observation and evidence packet it relies on.
The projection is a read-only derived artifact; it cannot write graph state, approve a recommendation, or activate a release.

state_rules.candidate_ready_with_counterevidence: All required dimensions are CURRENT and each requested claim is READY_WITH_COUNTEREVIDENCE.
state_rules.candidate_with_gaps: All required dimensions are CURRENT and at least one requested claim is READY_SUPPORT_ONLY; recommendation posture remains CANDIDATE_ONLY.
state_rules.hitl_required: Any required observation is CONFLICT or any requested claim is HITL_REQUIRED.
state_rules.stale_or_unknown: Any required observation is STALE_OR_UNKNOWN or any requested claim is STALE_OR_UNKNOWN.

required_cases: current observations with reviewed support and counterevidence

dependency_posture.w12_approved_migration: not required for the provider-free projection; required before writing target concepts to the active graph
dependency_posture.w5_trust_foundation: required before any W14 output is projected
